meta.title: FairGuide — Experience Uzbekistan through its people
meta.desc: FairGuide connects international visitors with trusted local guides and translators in Uzbekistan — with transparent price tools, verified profiles and real local experiences.
hero.title: Experience Uzbekistan through its people.
hero.sub: Find trusted local guides, discover authentic experiences, and travel with confidence — all in one place.
alt.hero: An international tourist laughing with a local Uzbek guide on a historic street in Samarkand, with blue-tiled madrasahs behind them.
value.quote: Travel should be about discovering a place — not worrying about whether you can trust the person helping you.
pillars.title: A fairer way to experience Uzbekistan.
pillars.lead: FairGuide connects international visitors with trusted local people — and helps you navigate language, local services and prices, so the country opens itself to you honestly.
pillars.p1d: Connect with verified local guides and translators.
pillars.p2d: Use FairGuide’s technology to better understand local prices and avoid unnecessary confusion.
pillars.p3d: Experience Uzbekistan through local people, students, and families.
problem.title: Traveling somewhere new should feel exciting — not uncertain.
problem.p1: Uzbekistan is one of the world’s most welcoming countries. But as an international visitor, you may not speak Uzbek or Russian — and you may have no way of knowing whether a price you’re quoted is a reasonable one.
problem.p2: So you depend on a guide or translator to communicate with local businesses. That dependency creates an
problem.floatT: What is a fair price here?
problem.floatD: When you don’t speak the language, every price is a guess.
problem.note: FairGuide is built to give you greater transparency, so you can make better-informed decisions. Prices can legitimately vary by place and season — a difference alone never means fraud. Where reliable data exists, FairGuide simply gives you a fair reference to compare against.
alt.market: An Uzbek vendor showing ceramics to an international tourist couple at a bazaar stall full of spices, with a handwritten price tag.
guides.title: Meet your trusted local guide.
guides.lead: Browse guides and translators by language, location, experience, rating, availability and verification — and choose the person who fits your journey.

scanner.title: Know the price before you pay.
scanner.lead: FairGuide helps tourists compare available product information and reference prices, giving them more confidence when shopping in Uzbekistan.
scanner.s1d: Scan a barcode, a product, a price tag — or simply take a photo.
scanner.s2d: FairGuide compares what it finds with reference price data collected for that product and region.
scanner.s3d: You see the difference clearly — and decide what feels fair to you.
scanner.disclaimer: Reference prices may vary by store, location, and time. FairGuide does not determine whether a seller is fraudulent solely from a price difference.
volunteer.title: Turn your language skills into real-world experience.
volunteer.p1: FairGuide plans to introduce a volunteer program for Uzbek students and young people who want to help international tourists as volunteer translators and local assistants — building meaningful international experience for university applications and strong portfolios.
volunteer.c1: Volunteer your way: help tourists communicate, navigate the country and experience local culture.
volunteer.c2: Tourists do not pay to book a volunteer.
volunteer.c3: After the experience, tourists may voluntarily leave a tip if they want to.
volunteer.c4: Volunteers build a verified record of their completed sessions.
volunteer.msText: can make a volunteer eligible for a recommendation-letter pathway through FairGuide’s planned cooperation with Uzbekistan’s Ministry of Tourism and Cultural Heritage.
alt.volunteer: A young Uzbek female student helping an international backpacker with directions on a phone map in Tashkent.
host.title: Stay with locals. Experience the real Uzbekistan.
host.lead: FairGuide plans to allow Uzbek individuals and families to host international tourists — so a trip can become a friendship, not just an itinerary.
host.s1d: The tourist tells FairGuide where they want to go, when they are coming, how many days they will stay, and how many people are traveling.
host.s2d: Suitable Uzbek hosts and families can see relevant tourist requests.
host.s3d: If the host likes the request and the dates work, they can accept the tourist.
host.s4d: Each host family can determine its own accommodation price.
alt.host: An Uzbek family welcoming an international guest to an evening dinner with plov, fresh bread and tea in a traditional courtyard.

ways.c2d: Use the price scanner to better understand available reference prices.
ways.c3d: Future opportunity for Uzbek students to gain international experience.
ways.c4d: Future opportunity to experience Uzbekistan through Uzbek families.
uz.title: More than a destination. A community.
uz.p: From the blue domes of Samarkand to the tea houses of Tashkent — what you will remember is not only the architecture. It is the bread shared in a bazaar, the student who shows you the way, the family that treats you like their own.
uz.message: We believe the best way to understand a country is through the people who call it home.

fg.title: Are you a guide or translator?
fg.p: FairGuide aims to help professional local guides and translators reach international tourists — while building trust through rich profiles, honest reviews, verification and transparent information.
fg.b1d: Get discovered by visitors planning their Uzbekistan trip right now.
fg.b2t: Build trust with a verified profile
fg.b2d: Reviews, experience and verification help you stand out for the right reasons.
fg.b3d: Transparent information protects tourists — and the reputation of honest professionals like you.

st.title: For ambitious Uzbek students.
st.p: FairGuide’s future volunteer program is designed to give students real-world experience that matters — for their language, their confidence and their future applications.
st.b7: Potentially qualify for recommendation opportunities after completing the required verified sessions
st.sideQ: “Every session you volunteer is a story you can tell — in your application, in your CV, and in your own life.”

safety.title: Built around trust.
safety.lead: FairGuide is designed to build a trusted environment for both tourists and local users — with safeguards that grow alongside the community.
safety.f1d: Guides and translators go through identity and credential checks before appearing on the platform.
safety.f2d: Honest, experience-based reviews help great locals shine — and keep everyone accountable.
safety.f3d: Chat and booking stay inside FairGuide, with your information protected.
safety.f4d: See something wrong? Report it in one tap — our team reviews every case.
safety.f5d: Clear rules of fairness and respect that every member of the community agrees to.
safety.f6d: Stronger identity tools are planned as the platform and its community grow.
safety.note: No platform can promise that nothing bad will ever happen. We can promise constant work: better verification, faster response, and a community that looks out for each other.
about.title: Our vision
about.quote: “We want to make Uzbekistan one of the world’s most welcoming and trusted destinations by connecting international visitors with the people who know the country best.”
about.p1: FairGuide is building a bridge between international tourism and Uzbekistan’s local community — guides, translators, students, and families.
about.p2: Our long-term vision is a platform where tourism creates value not only for tourists and businesses, but for students, families, guides and local communities across the country.
